Implemented numerical and kernel pieces are recorded while general tensor, orchestration, PyTorch and backward correspondence remain unfinished.

Full graph validity and initialization-source forcing cover arbitrary whole-word aliases; actual trace labels are connected separately without general no-thin-air claims.
Exact Luna patch preserves prestate operands, guards, target feature check, typed decoder and original conservative numerical relation; all proofs complete.
Tagged dispatch lifts Scalar.eval none and Binary32.Eval exactly, with finite paths separate from terminal runs, origin, safety and frame proofs.
The source-section census remains unchanged; six selected accepted spellings are explicitly separate from assessment of whole sections.
Backward mathematical and separately authored PTX obligations are unchanged; no automatic PTX construction or derivative-kernel proof is inferred from an affine forward kernel.
Gemma remains deferred and unimplemented; no architecture, precision or application verification claim is introduced.
The affine example is one isolated launch; ordering, visibility, lifetime and combined-kernel promises remain unchanged and unfinished.
The existing two-rounding error theorem is consumed unchanged with its exact finite-input/range/error assumptions; no specification weakening.

results.evidence: Exact before/after tree identical. Strict six-form ledger and four evidence archives (542 members) pass; worker54 and ledger26 regression tests pass. Root604 and integration204 exact dependency reports permit only standard Lean axioms. Fresh binary32 candidate003 replay, all28 instruction reports,44 mixed-execution reports,30 affine-memory reports and47 affine-kernel reports reviewed; concrete disjoint/all-alias runs pass. The compile-preserving omitted-read probe fails exactly the intended assertion. Logs /tmp/ptxlean-affine-root-final.log and /tmp/ptxlean-affine-joint-final.log; detailed reviews and immutable trial evidence in proposal. NaN realizability, runtime conformance and general concurrent PTX admission remain outside this result.
